title: [HIRING] Agency Operations & AI Systems Builder | Remote, part-time
text: We’re hiring at Beyond Creator, Canada’s first AI-powered marketing agency, founded in Toronto. We produce 200+ pieces of content each month for restaurants and hospitality brands. We’re looking for someone who enjoys understanding how a creative team works, keeping projects moving, and building practical tools that people actually use. The work Help keep priorities, deadlines and handoffs clear in Notion and Slack. Build useful AI workflows with n8n, APIs and webhooks. Write, debug and publish small applications. Test the workflows, handle failures and document how they work. Bring good visual judgment and an understanding of marketing or creative production. This is an ongoing remote, part-time role, starting at about 15 hours per week, with room to grow as the collaboration develops. Applications are welcome from Canada, Türkiye and elsewhere. Clear English and some overlap with Toronto working hours matter. Turkish is a plus. Show us something you built A useful personal AI project counts. Please share the problem, what you personally built, a demo and a code sample or published app. We’d also like one example of a project you helped coordinate. A CV is optional. Apply through our form: Notion Notion | Where teams and agents work together Made in Notion, the connected workspace where AI agents and teams organize docs, projects and knowledge together. If you have already completed this form for the role, there is no need to submit it again. Company: https://beyondcreator.ca Replies are closed - contact the author using email, application form or direct message. Read more here . 1 post - 2 participants Read full topic

title: Looking for AI Systems & Superhuman Docs contractor
text: Stand-in systems support for The Future Society The Future Society (TFS) is looking for a contractor to cover our internal systems from 11 to 28 December 2026, with the potential to stay on as ongoing backup. About us TFS is a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit working on AI governance. Our staff are mostly in Europe and North America. Bell Arden builds and maintains our internal systems, and we’re looking for somebody to cover our systems during periods of Bell’s leave. We are looking for someone available in December for cover, with the potential to extend the arrangement in the longer term. The work There are two parts: a short period of cover in December, then a potential extension as a light ongoing engagement. Cover from 11 to 28 December. You keep our systems running while Bell is away. That means watching the automated alerts, working out what has gone wrong, and keeping small problems from becoming big ones. How much you fix yourself will depend on your experience and what we agree beforehand. Bell can be reached by message during this period for anything that needs a decision. You would be needed for a few hours of onboarding in early December. Ongoing backup. If the initial period goes well, we would consider this person to provide ongoing backup support. What you would cover: Our AI knowledge system on Google Cloud. This is a custom MCP server that gives staff access to TFS’s data through Claude. It runs on Cloud Run and Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), with nightly data syncs and a set of automated monitoring checks. Our Coda (Superhuman Docs) workspace.This is where most of TFS’s operations run: tables, formulas, automations. How the work gets done .The systems are built and maintained with Claude Code. The codebase & the TFS MCP server carry detailed operating instructions and documentation for it. In practice you would direct Claude Code through the work and check what it proposes. You would not be writing code yourself. What we’re looking for Essential Substantial Claude Code experience on a real production system - You can direct it through unfamiliar work, read what it proposes, and push back or stop it when it is wrong. A working understanding of relational databases - You can reason about tables, joins and schema changes; ideally, you’ve worked with PostgreSQL. Good judgement about when not to act - In a system you didn’t build, a careful diagnosis and a well-timed message often beat a confident fix. Discretion - The role involves access to sensitive organisational and staff data, so you will need to sign and adhere to a confidentiality agreement. Strongly preferred Experience building or running an MCP server , or a similar integration between AI models and real data. Coda experience , specifically complex formulas, table configurations, and automations. Extensive experience with Notion or Airtable is a good substitute. Nice to have Python. Google Cloud, especially reading logs and working with Cloud Run. Operations experience in a small nonprofit. Time and terms December cover - 11–28 December 2026, about 1–2 hours a day on weekdays (roughly 15–20 hours in total). Onboarding - A few paid hours with Bell in early December, before the cover starts | Ongoing - [if extended] A monthly check-in of about 2 hours, plus cover for future absences. Location - Remote. A time zone between UTC+0 and UTC+12 is a plus, but working asynchronously is fine. Contract - Paid contract with an individual or a firm. How to apply Email Bell Arden at bell.arden@thefuturesociety.org by 24 November 2026 . Please include: your relevant experience, especially with Claude Code and AI systems, databases and Coda (or Notion or Airtable) your availability from 11 to 28 December your rate, hourly or daily We will contact applicants to arrange a short call. 1 post - 1 participant Read full topic
triage_reason: A non-profit is hiring a systems contractor for December coverage.
